可数名词，可指音乐乐器或科学仪器

meanings.meaning: 新概念英语正版图书购买
★shock　v. 使不悦或生气，震惊

meanings.usage: 及物动词，常用结构：be allowed to do
副词，修饰动词，表示力度大
及物动词，表示将某物保存在某处
副词，通常与过去时连用
可数名词，指爸爸或妈妈的爸爸

phrases.usage: 属于，表示所有权或归属关系

examples.en: This house belongs to our family.

phrases.usage: 尝试做某事，努力去做但不一定成功

phrases.usage: 感到震惊，表示对某事感到惊讶

examples.en: My father was shocked when he heard the news.
examples.zh: 我父亲听到这个消息时很震惊。

examples.en: Now we are not allowed to touch it.
examples.zh: 现在我们不被允许碰它。

examples.en: She struck the keys too hard.
It was made in Germany in 1681.

phrases.usage: 很多年前，表示过去的时间

examples.en: The instrument was bought many years ago.
examples.zh: 这件乐器是多年前买的。

phrases.usage: 正在被...，现在进行时的被动语态

examples.en: It is being repaired by a friend of my father's.
examples.zh: 它正在被我父亲的一个朋友修理。

phrases.usage: 我父亲的...朋友，双重所有格用法

examples.en: It is being repaired by a friend of my father's.
examples.zh: 它正在被我父亲的一个朋友修理。

phrases.usage: 最近，用于谈论近期发生的事情

examples.en: Recently it was damaged by a visitor.
examples.zh: 最近它被一个访客损坏了。

grammar.title: 一般过去时的被动语态
grammar.structure: 主语 + was/were + 过去分词 (+ by + 动作执行者)
grammar.definition: 当主语是动作的承受者时，使用被动语态。过去时的被动语态表示过去某个动作施加于主语 用于描述过去发生的动作，主语是动作的承受者

examples.en: It was made in Germany in 1681.
The instrument was bought by my grandfather many years ago.
examples.zh: 这件乐器是多年前被我祖父买的。

examples.en: It was damaged by a visitor recently.
examples.zh: 它最近被一个访客损坏了。

grammar.title: 现在进行时的被动语态
grammar.structure: 主语 + am/is/are + being + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 表示说话时正在进行的被动动作，即某事正在被做 强调某个动作正在进行中，且主语是动作的承受者

examples.en: It is being repaired by a friend of my father's.
examples.zh: 它正在被我父亲的一个朋友修理。

examples.en: The house is being painted now.
The work is being done by the students.

grammar.title: 时间表达：ago与recently
grammar.definition: ago表示从现在算起的过去时间点，recently表示离现在不远的时间 ago用于过去时，recently可用于过去时或现在完成时

examples.en: She bought it many years ago.
Recently it was damaged by a visitor.
examples.zh: 最近它被一个访客损坏了。

patterns.pattern: It was made in + 地点 + 时间

imitations.en: It was made in China in 2020.

patterns.pattern: It has belonged to... for + 时间段

patterns.pattern: It is being + 过去分词 + by...

original.zh: 它正在被我父亲的一个朋友修理。

imitations.en: The car is being washed by Tom.
The room is being cleaned by my mother.
imitations.zh: 房间正在被我妈妈打扫。

lines.en: Not For Jazz We have an old musical instrument.
lines.zh: 我们有一件古老的乐器,叫击弦古钢琴。

lines.en: It is called a clavichord . It was made in Germany in 1681.
lines.zh: 它是1681年德国制造的,我们这架钢琴放在客厅里。

lines.en: Our clavichord is kept in the living-room .
lines.zh: 我们家拥有它很长时间了,这件乐器是许多年前我祖父买来的。

lines.en: It has belonged to our family for a long time. The instrument was bought by my grandfather many years ago.
lines.zh: 最近它被一位客人弄坏了,她用它弹奏爵士乐!她按键太猛,把两根弦按断了。

lines.en: Recently it was damaged by a visitor.
She tried to play jazz on it!
lines.zh: 现在他不允许我们再碰它。

lines.en: She struck the keys too hard and two of the strings were broken.
lines.zh: 父亲的一位朋友正在修理这件古老的乐器。

lines.en: My father was shocked. Now we are not allowed to touch it. It is being repaired by a friend of my father's.

translation:
我们有一件古老的乐器,叫击弦古钢琴。
它是1681年德国制造的,我们这架钢琴放在客厅里。
我们家拥有它很长时间了,这件乐器是许多年前我祖父买来的。
最近它被一位客人弄坏了,她用它弹奏爵士乐!她按键太猛,把两根弦按断了。
我父亲为之震怒。
现在他不允许我们再碰它。
父亲的一位朋友正在修理这件古老的乐器。

title: Not for Jazz
subtitle: 不适于演奏爵士乐

lead.question: 一件 1681 年的德国古钢琴，为何禁止家人再碰它？
lead.warmup: 想象客厅里摆着一件 1681 年德国造的乐器：音色古雅，却被禁止演奏。它叫击弦古钢琴，与现代钢琴不同，靠压弦发声，弦细而脆。祖父多年前买下它，成了家里的传家宝。一天来客兴起，非要在这件古董上弹一段爵士乐，两根弦应声而断。父亲震怒，下令谁也不许再碰。全篇被动句交代它的身世、遭遇与现状。
goals: 听懂并复述这架击弦古钢琴的来历、受损经过与现状
掌握被动语态一般过去时 It was made in Germany in 1681 的结构与用法
辨清 belong to、be called、damage、strike、allow 等本课核心词语
能把主动句改写为被动句，如 The instrument was bought by my grandfather
lead.summary: 本课围绕一件名为 clavichord 的古乐器展开：它 1681 年德国制造，存放于客厅，由祖父购入、传家多年；最近被一位执意弹爵士乐的客人敲断两根弦，父亲震怒后不许家人触碰，如今正由他的一位朋友修理。重点掌握 was made in、is kept、was damaged by、is being repaired，以及 belong to 与 for 连用的现在完成时。
lead.tips: belong to 无被动也无进行时，表示拥有多年要说 It has belonged to our family for a long time；另注意 allow sb to do 转被动为 be allowed to do。

questions.q: What happened to the clavichord recently?
questions.zh: 最近那架击弦古钢琴出了什么事？
questions.a: It was damaged by a visitor who tried to play jazz on it.
questions.aZh: 它被一位客人弄坏了，那位客人想用它弹奏爵士乐。
questions.hint: 出处：Recently it was damaged by a visitor. 以及 She tried to play jazz on it!

questions.q: What is the instrument called, and when and where was it made?
questions.zh: 这件乐器叫什么名字？何时何地制造？
questions.a: It is called a clavichord. It was made in Germany in 1681.
questions.aZh: 它叫击弦古钢琴，是 1681 年德国制造的。
questions.hint: 出处：It is called a clavichord. It was made in Germany in 1681。

questions.zh: 我父亲为什么感到震惊、不悦？
questions.a: Because a visitor struck the keys too hard while playing jazz and broke two of the strings.
questions.aZh: 因为一位客人弹爵士乐时按键太猛，把两根弦弄断了。
questions.hint: 出处：She struck the keys too hard and two of the strings were broken。

questions.q: How long has the clavichord belonged to the family and who bought it?
questions.zh: 这件乐器属于这个家庭多久了？谁买来的？
questions.a: It has belonged to their family for a long time. It was bought by their grandfather many years ago.
questions.aZh: 它属于他们家很久了，是许多年前祖父买来的。
questions.hint: 出处：It has belonged to our family for a long time. The instrument was bought by my grandfather many years ago。

questions.q: Why is the title 'Not for Jazz' appropriate? Is jazz itself forbidden?
questions.zh: 标题“不适于演奏爵士乐”贴切在哪里？被禁的是爵士乐吗？
questions.a: It refers to the instrument, not the music: a fragile clavichord made in 1681 cannot stand the hard striking jazz requires. What the father really forbids is the family's touching it, since now they are not allowed to touch it.
questions.aZh: 被限制的是琴而不是音乐：1681 年的古钢琴弦细而脆，经不起爵士乐那样猛烈的按键。父亲真正禁止的是家人再碰它。
questions.hint: 结合 She tried to play jazz on it!、two of the strings were broken 与 Now we are not allowed to touch it. 推断。

exercises.q: 汉译英：我们有一件古老的乐器，它叫击弦古钢琴。
exercises.a: We have an old musical instrument. It is called a clavichord.

exercises.q: 汉译英：它是 1681 年德国制造的。
exercises.a: It was made in Germany in 1681.
exercises.note: 被动语态一般过去时 was made。

exercises.q: 句型转换：We keep our clavichord in the living-room.（改为被动语态）
exercises.a: Our clavichord is kept in the living-room.
exercises.note: 一般现在时被动 is kept。

exercises.q: 主动变被动：Recently a visitor damaged it.
exercises.a: Recently it was damaged by a visitor.

exercises.q: 汉译英：她按键太猛，把两根弦弄断了。
exercises.a: She struck the keys too hard and two of the strings were broken.
exercises.note: strike 过去式 struck，hard 作副词。

exercises.q: 汉译英：我父亲为之震怒。现在我们不允许再碰它。
exercises.a: My father was shocked. Now we are not allowed to touch it.
exercises.note: allow sb to do 的被动为 be allowed to do。

exercises.q: 改错：It is belonged to our family for a long time.
exercises.a: It has belonged to our family for a long time.
exercises.note: belong to 无被动、无进行时。
